dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Finished manuscript map of Columbus and vicinity, Ky., displaying roads, city streets without names, buildings, drainage, some vegetation, "Mobile and Ohio R.R.," and the location of "abattis or felled trees" which obstructed the approaches to the fortifications.
In the lower right corner: Engr. Dept. July 18/64. Recd. with Gen. Cullum's letter of the 16th inst. (C.5621).
Includes six "Cross sections of the different intrenchments" and a list of references.
Relief shown by hachures and spot heights.
